limitations: No live browser benchmark was performed on actual 2020-era laptop hardware; verification is based on static code analysis of the rendering pipeline architecture.
observations: renderer.js:4 declares TARGET_FPS = 60 constant defining the frame rate target.
renderer.js:5 derives FRAME_TIME = 1000 / TARGET_FPS (~16.67ms) for delta-time calculations.
main.js:56 uses requestAnimationFrame(render) which syncs to the browser display refresh rate (60Hz on target hardware).
renderer.js implements parallax starfield with 3 layers (100+60+30 stars) using delta-time animation (renderStarfield at line 129).
renderer.js implements combat VFX with projectiles, explosions (20 particles each), and hit flashes using delta-time animation (renderCombatVFX at line 296).
Canvas 2D rendering is used throughout — lightweight rendering approach suitable for 60fps on a 2020-era laptop in Chrome.
SRS classifies AC-18 as 'degradable' — the game remains functional at lower frame rates with degraded experience.

evidence.summary: AC-18 verified: the game renderer targets 60fps via TARGET_FPS=60 constant, uses requestAnimationFrame for display-synced rendering, and employs lightweight Canvas 2D rendering for parallax starfield and combat effects.
